description: Real OpenClaw in a disposable VM.
why: ai.openclaw.mac is the REAL bundle id, read off a live 2026.7.1 install. The design said bot.molt.mac and that was wrong - it would have missed the demo's punchline on every Mac. The cask's zap stanza still lists bot.molt.mac paths, which is what misled us: zap enumerates artifacts to clean up including historical ones, so it is a superset of current identity, never a source for the bundle id. brew is >=1 because homebrew_packages DOES cover casks (it has a type column). daemon and port are 0 and are carried by 60-persistence: verified on a live install that OpenClaw registers no launchd job and no state dir until it is GUI-launched, which SSH cannot do.
